review_candidates.description: Job Summary We are looking for a Senior System Administrator to manage, maintain, and troubleshoot the company's servers, systems, virtualization, cloud infrastructure, backups, monitoring, and security. The ideal candidate should be hands-on, proactive, and experienced in managing Windows and Linux environments and supporting a reliable and secure IT infrastructure. Experience working in a software or technology company is preferred. CCNA/CCNP or relevant Microsoft, VMware, Azure, or cloud certifications are an advantage. Good communication and documentation skills.
